I.value_zh: fcop-rules.mdc、fcop-protocol.mdc、现有 Rule 0..8、ADR-0015、metadata 一致性测试与 CHANGELOG。
I.value_en: fcop-rules.mdc, fcop-protocol.mdc, existing Rules 0..8, ADR-0015, metadata consistency tests, and CHANGELOG.
I.notes_zh: 不加载用户项目的宿主规则。
I.notes_en: No host rules from user projects are loaded.

O.value_zh: rules.mdc 的 Rule 9 四子段和 1.9.0 元数据/changelog；protocol.mdc 的 v1.0 capabilities pointer、1.7.0 元数据/version log；报告归档。
O.value_en: Rule 9 four subparts and 1.9.0 metadata/changelog in rules.mdc; v1.0 capabilities pointer, 1.7.0 metadata/version log in protocol.mdc; report/archive.
O.notes_zh: 输出未被当作已写入事实。
O.notes_en: Outputs are not treated as already written.

A.value_zh: 以两轮提交增补 rules/protocol/CHANGELOG，并进行 metadata 一致性和全回归验证。
A.value_en: Use two commits to add rules/protocol/CHANGELOG content and run metadata-consistency and full-regression validation.
A.notes_en: This adjudication does not rewrite documents.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 发起；ME solo 执行；Cursor、Claude、Codex 仅是预期读取规则文件的宿主 agent。
P.value_en: ADMIN originates; ME executes solo; Cursor, Claude, and Codex are only host agents expected to read rule files.
P.notes_zh: 不推导任何 agent 权限。

R.value_zh: 原文未规定本任务的执行期限或资源预算；P1 是优先级，两轮是执行计划，版本号、Rule 9 四子段及回归要求属于交付与验收范围。
R.value_en: The source sets no execution deadline or resource budget for this task; P1 is priority, two rounds are an execution plan, and version numbers, four Rule 9 subsections, and regression requirements define delivery and acceptance scope.
R.notes_zh: 版本演进仍保留在交付、依据与形式模型；不把路线阶段或验收数量当资源上限。
R.notes_en: Version changes remain in delivery, provenance, and the formal model; roadmap stages and acceptance counts are not resource caps.

V.value_zh: ADR-0015、Rule 0..8 既有形式、ISSUE-20260427-007 与严格 SemVer additive 原则。
V.value_en: ADR-0015, existing Rule 0..8 form, ISSUE-20260427-007, and strict SemVer additive principle.

C.value_zh: 五项验收：Rule 9 双语四子段、rules 版本/日志、protocol pointer、protocol 版本/日志、metadata 测试和全回归。
C.value_en: Five criteria: Rule 9 bilingual four subparts, rules version/log, protocol pointer, protocol version/log, metadata test and full regression.

B.value_zh: 不得改动 Rule 0..8 主体；protocol.mdc 不得展开详细 commentary；不得产生 metadata drift；仅允许 additive expansion。
B.value_en: Do not alter Rules 0..8 bodies; do not expand detailed commentary in protocol.mdc; do not cause metadata drift; allow additive expansion only.
B.notes_zh: Rule 9 是唯一新增正式规则。
B.notes_en: Rule 9 is the sole new formal rule.
